## Summary

Describe the behavior or documentation changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant tests pass.
- [ ] Documentation builds without warnings when documentation changed.
- [ ] Packaging succeeds when package or release metadata changed.

## Data safety

- [ ] This change contains no credentials, private genotype data, restricted datasets, or
      host-specific paths.
- [ ] Any added test data are synthetic or have clear redistribution terms and provenance.

## Notes for reviewers

Call out unresolved assumptions, compatibility changes, or follow-up work here.
